授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Surface and interface of materials are known to have different structures, characteristics and functions from those of bulk materials. Nanostructured materials composed of molecules or atoms exposing to atmosphere exhibit often quite unique, novel characteristics. This lecture derivers fundamentals of surface and interfaces in vacuum, air and liquid along with surface-sensitive characterization techniques. The latest nano-fabrication techniques such as topdown and bottom-up methods are also provided. This is an introductory course to learn nanosceince and nanotechnology for chemistry students.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Nanoscience, Nanotechnology, Self-assembly, Nanofabrication, Surface sensitive analysis
